title: Alexander the Great takes Egypt
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Taking Africa for Jesus). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 14 November, 332 BC (AP-5). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 330 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-5: Alexander Conquers Egypt: 14 November, 332 BC"
chronologies.note: Alexander's proclamation as king of Egypt; CFAH-3 calls it "the most precisely dated event of Alexander's life".

chronologies.citation: Taking Africa for Jesus, ch. 4 "Egypt (Part 3)", PDF p. 43 (printed p. 43)
Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 5 "The Egyptian Empire (2450–332 BC)", PDF p. 157 (printed p. 156)
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "332 BC" (PDF p. 100): the same date.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 5 "The Babel Rebellion", PDF p. 100 (printed p. 86)
